title: Make the sheet spreadsheet engine follow its spec
prompt: This directory holds sheet, a small spreadsheet engine in Python: a formula tokenizer and parser, an evaluator with typed values and error values, a set of built-in functions, a dependency graph with incremental recalculation, copying and row/column insertion and deletion, and CSV input and output, in the sheet/ package, with run.py as the command (`python3 run.py BOOK.csv [EDITS]`). It does not behave as SPEC.md describes: some of the examples in examples/ give the wrong result (`python3 run_examples.py` runs them all and compares each with its expected.txt). Fix the implementation so that it follows SPEC.md in every respect; more tests than the visible examples check the whole of SPEC.md. Do not modify SPEC.md, run_examples.py or anything in examples/. Code must run on /usr/bin/python3 (Python 3.9), the interpreter the checks use; standard library only.
